When the source states only an annual or multi-month price, set $.extras.monthly_usd to the monthly equivalent and put the arithmetic in 'derived'. When the currency has no dated rate in the corpus, price_on_page keeps the currency as stated; never convert without a rate and never guess one. When the record's evidence shows no price exists at all (dead domain, walled page, no price published), set $.extras.price_note to 'not published: ' plus what the evidence shows. Cite the record's own evidence rows (their url, capture hash and quote) as the evidence of each op; add a new capture only when no existing row carries the price. Write 'not published' for a renewal no page prints. Reuse the existing capture hash exactly as the record holds it; do not re-read the web. Rewrite any free text of the record that the new values contradict.
